body:
Known issues. The rule: each `P1` and `P2` issue that is open at 2026-11-28T09:44Z and is not on the cut list of 0.28.0 (`gh issue list --state open --search 'label:P1,P2' --limit 200`, minus #4341, #4133 and #4431). The list has 46 issues. Their fixes ship in the next minor. `RELEASE_NOTES.md` has the same list.

- #4513 (P1): doosan-dnm indexing path posts the A word with the opposite
  sign for a lone rotary along -X, and the travel check passes (filed after
  the cut line).
- #4511 (P1): Fanuc and Doosan posts: a setup-change stop after a tilted
  section lifts Z with G43.4 still armed (filed after the cut line).
- #4496 (P1): Generic component editor: a gauge-length edit redraws a user
  holder with the library body found by name, which can be thinner than the
  real steel (filed after the cut line).
- #4455 (P1): Holder form: the Largest diameter field of a copied holder
  reads 50.0 but the drawing shows Ø63 (filed after the cut line).
- #4436 (P1): Fanuc and Doosan DNM posts ignore a rotary's sign_convention
  table_rh under G43.4.
- #4417 (P1): Fanuc post writes stream A/B words that a tilt-head chain (A
  carries B) reads as a different tool axis.
- #4407 (P2): Path kernel: no silent recovery from a rejected result, and
  the stale record citations (review of #4383, class B).
- #4406 (P2): Path kernel law suite: each law assertion can break, and a
  refusal is never held (review of #4383, class A).
- #4269 (P2): Path kernel: the converter from a kernel plan to a toolpath,
  in camcraft-motion.
- #4254 (P2): Path kernel: an Outside piece starts at its end on the stock
  edge, with a proved approach from the air (the 13 and 15 lifts).
- #4178 (P2): Path kernel K5: the entry and exit stage (a proof for each
  entry, a named fallback, the Exit type).
- #4177 (P2): Path kernel K4: the order stage and the link stage (stay down,
  a named reason for each lift).
- #4176 (P2): Path kernel K2: the guide stage (rings, rows, medial line,
  trace, helix).
- #4154 (P2): Path kernel K7a: measure the kernel laws on a finished
  toolpath, and pin the readings of the old planners.
- #4153 (P2): Path kernel: record the old-planner baseline for each phase-1
  kind that has none.
- #4055 (P2): Path kernel: the camcraft-pathkernel crate skeleton, the stage
  types and the one switch.
- #4038 (P2): Path kernel phase 1: Thread plans through the path kernel on
  side/path-kernel.
- #4037 (P2): Path kernel phase 1: Slot Undercut plans through the path
  kernel on side/path-kernel.
- #4036 (P2): Path kernel phase 1: Trochoidal slot plans through the path
  kernel on side/path-kernel.
- #4035 (P2): Path kernel phase 1: Slot plans through the path kernel on
  side/path-kernel.
- #4034 (P2): Path kernel phase 1: V-Carve plans through the path kernel on
  side/path-kernel.
- #4027 (P2): Path kernel K7: one test suite that checks each strategy
  against the kernel laws.
- #4026 (P2): Path kernel K3: one load control stage for trochoidal and
  constant engagement passes.
- #4025 (P2): Path kernel K1: one region model for selection, material side
  and bounds.
- #4023 (P2): Path kernel: one motion planning pipeline for all strategies.
- #4004 (P1): Dovetail cutters: read the corner radius (`corner_r` is
  accepted but ignored, so the flank is too thin).
- #3934 (P1): Pass starts at Outside: every strategy clears in straight
  lines, not along the stock and the selected edge.
- #3933 (P2): 2D Pocket offset rings: waterline-like passes with a nominal
  engagement, not a constant-engagement spiral.
- #3759 (P2): Face and the 2D Adaptive Outside plan: air entries through the
  shared entry rule, Adaptive lifts with a named reason (identical output).
- #3758 (P2): Trace, Engrave and 2D Chamfer: loop changes on the shared ring
  linker, with a named reason for each lift (identical output).
- #3757 (P2): 2D Contour: level links and wall entries on the shared ring
  linker and entry rule (identical output).
- #3756 (P1): Bore: rings on the shared circle ring set, as arcs by the
  chord tolerance, linked at depth with no lift between rings.
- #3755 (P1): Circular: cut the rings of a level in one walk at depth; no
  lift and no new entry into material at each ring.
- #3754 (P2): Do not touch, the 2D Adaptive ring fallback and the 3D Pocket
  levels on the shared ring set (identical output).
- #3753 (P2): 2D Pocket rest machining and the Zigzag closing rings on the
  shared ring set: one chain law (identical output).
- #3752 (P1): 2D Pocket: Waterline, OffsetRings, Inside and Outside on the
  shared ring set; rings link in the plane and lift only with a named
  reason.
- #3750 (P1): 2D ring planning step 1: one shared ring set, ring linker and
  entry rule, taken from the 2D Offset path (identical output).
- #3746 (P1): 2D Offset Pass starts at Inside and Outside: enter in air
  outside the stock box, then an arc lead-in in the cut plane with Arc
  radius and Arc sweep.
- #3331 (P2): Start and exit points: turning kinds (start in the Z-X plane).
- #3330 (P2): Start and exit points: multi-axis kinds (5-axis, swarf,
  rotary, flow, multi-axis rough and contour).
- #3327 (P2): Start and exit points: 2D Adaptive (entry of the first pass,
  end of the last pass).
- #3325 (P2): Start and exit points: 2D ring and chain kinds (Pocket,
  Offset, Circular, Slot, Trochoidal slot, Trace, Engrave, Chamfer).
- #2629 (P2): GPU stock sim S3: viewport playback cuts on the GPU, with CPU
  fallback.
- #2424 (P2): Windows 11, desktop Ryzen 5 with onboard Radeon: the whole PC
  freezes with screen "snow" while CamCraft v0.23.0 runs.
- #1473 (P2): Start and exit points: exit points, viewport pick, and the
  cases the first contour slice refuses.
- #1448 (P2): Operations: user-set start and exit points, path regenerated
  to them.

#4472 is closed: PR #4405 in this release fixes it.

Decisions in `RECOMMENDED.md`: `cargo xtask decisions` removed 155 files (154 in 23566b976, 1 in 69f19a0e6). The text of each file is in the `v0.28.0` section exactly one time, and there are no duplicates. A count of the `## ` lines in the section gives 180 because some files have sub-headings, for example "## Decision" and "## Dropped". The file names have 135 unique issue numbers because some issues have more than one file, for example #1120 and #4213.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 69f19a0e6baa1d6537c6d4b4ad726c6502b8a6f6 -->

Release-cut step 3 review (v0.28.0). Verdict: **needs changes** — two wrong entries in the release notes, one small gap in the process section. No code was checked. The draft stays as is; this is a comment, not an approval.

Verified (docs and metadata only — 160 files changed, 0 `.rs` files, no `crates/`, no `scripts/`, no `.github/`):
- `Cargo.toml`: one version line (0.27.0 -> 0.28.0). `Cargo.lock`: 13 package bumps (0.27.0 -> 0.28.0). Nothing else changed.
- `RELEASE_NOTES.md` (298 lines): header, Breaking (project file 82 -> 84, .camtools 7/8, was 6), upgrade notes, changes to posted G-code (incl. #4341 superseding #4371, and the seven post-freeze PRs), highlights, merged-after-freeze, not-exercised-on-a-real-control and pixel-snapshot sections are all present and agree with git. No section claims a gate passed.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: 128 rows with version 0.28.0. Every row's date matches its merge commit's date. The final PR ref in each row matches the merge subject of its commit. 0 mismatches in 128 rows.
- `RECOMMENDED.md`: one `## v0.28.0` heading (line 83577) and 155 restored decision files. Every deleted `docs/decisions/*.md` heading appears under it. 0 missing of 155. The task listed `4326-path-kernel-delivery.md` in the spot-check set; that file does not exist — the real record is `4325-path-kernel-delivery.md` (line 90798), which is present.
- Cut-line discipline: every merge after the freeze notice is either the seven recorded post-freeze PRs (#4467, #4298, #4442, #4425, #4458, #4459, #4460, between 00:01Z and 00:02Z on 2026-11-28), #4405 (the red-main exception), #4509 (cut-list #4341, takes over #4371, merged 2026-11-28T08:34Z), or the side-kernel merges (#4437, #4497). The body's claim that no other PR merged into `main` after 2394b5ad1 except #4509 is accurate (the only other merge after it is the branch merge 8de6912e2 into the takeover branch).
- `PROCESS_VERSION` 155 -> 166; the Process changes section lists 156-166 (11 entries).
- Known issues: the PR comment (2026-11-28T08:35Z) lists 45 open P1/P2 issues — 12 P1 and 33 P2 (verified against the live `gh issue list --state open`). This is the correct set.

Findings:
- `RELEASE_NOTES.md` line 177-267: #4496 (P1, in-review, UI) is missing from "All open `P1` and `P2` issues". It is in the PR comment. Each open P1/P2 not on the cut list must be in the release notes.
- `RELEASE_NOTES.md` line 180: #4472 is listed as open ("main is red (post-merge gate)") but it is CLOSED — the fix (#4431, PR #4405) is in this release. Remove it from the open list.
- `RELEASE_NOTES.md` lines 288-291: version 166 is listed as #4440 plus #4333, #4268, #4247, #4388 and #4397. The freeze notice (2026-11-27T23:13Z) records that version 166 also covers the process files of #4449 (xtask: native expected config paths on Windows) and #4423 (camcraft-mcp skill: pattern folders at the post). Those two are missing from the section.
- Informational, non-blocking: the notes say "192 pull requests merged since 0.27.0". Git shows 194 unique PR numbers in `v0.27.0..origin/main`. A two-count delta. Worth a one-line refresh.

Not run. No build ran for this PR. No quick, batch or release gate ran. No cut gate, no runner, no heavy lanes, no pixel-snapshot lanes. The body says the cut gate has not run (no online cut runner has zola and node); that is unchanged and is the maintainer's step. The pixel-snapshot lanes and the Windows arms of the per-OS readings did not run (no Windows machine). No review label was set, nothing was approved, nothing was merged, nothing was flagged ready, and no file or PR body was changed.

Review fixes on head a893e1ad2 (commit `docs: 0.28.0 notes - review fixes`), for the review of 09:16Z on 69f19a0e6:
1. Known issues: the list is generated again from all open `P1` and `P2` issues, minus the cut-list items (45 issues). It includes #4496 and #4511. #4472 is closed and is not in the list; the notes say that PR #4405 fixes it. The Known issues comment is edited to agree.
2. Process version 166 names #4449 and #4423. Versions 156-165 agree with #681.
3. PR count: 193 unique merged PRs since v0.27.0 (192 up to 2394b5ad1, plus #4509).
The new head waits for a fresh review. No cut gate has run.

<!-- pr-reviewer: a893e1ad29a2fa9bc06f0d51f877583ffcc0c02d -->

Delta re-review of PR #4512 (0.28.0 release PR) at head a893e1ad2. No build, no gate, no heavy lane, no CI, no runner ran for this review. This is a docs/release-mechanics PR; the cut gate remains the maintainer's action.

Verdict: the three delta findings are fixed, and the delta did not touch the rest of the release files. The headline numbers in the notes are still stale; the notes need one numbers pass before this is safe to flag.

Findings:
1. #4496 (P1, OPEN, in-review) appears in both the "Known issues" needs-attention bullet list and the "All open P1 and P2 issues" list. Confirmed at lines ~172-177 and ~187-189 of RELEASE_NOTES.md. OK.
2. #4472 (CLOSED; red-main fix #4431, PR #4405, merged) is removed from the open-issues list, and the new paragraph about the red-main fix exists (lines ~142-145): "The red `main` of the two `wire_post` tests (#4431, #4472) is fixed in this release by PR #4405". Confirmed. OK.
3. The process-changes section (version 166) names #4449 (`xtask`: native expected config paths on Windows) and #4423 (`camcraft-mcp` skill: pattern folders at the post) together with #4440, #4333, #4247, #4388, #4397 and #4268. All seven names appear in the section (lines ~297-303). Confirmed. OK.
4. The headline "193 pull requests merged since 0.27.0" is NOT reproduced by the empirical count. A merge-subject sweep of v0.27.0..origin/release/v0.28.0 (`git rev-list ... --merges --format='%s' | grep -oE 'pull request #[0-9]+'`) gives 194 unique PRs; the identical set is `v0.27.0..origin/main` (194, same numbers). Classification of the 194 titles by prefix: 64 feat, 77 fix, 2 perf, 10 refactor, 10 docs, 14 test, 15 chore, 1 ci, 1 NO_PREFIX (no conventional prefix, #3968 "DXF import: MPOLYGON ..."). The breaks: total 193 vs 194 (one short), features 58 vs 64 (six short). Fixes (77), perf (2) and refactors (10) match exactly. The notes do not state which PR is excluded. The closest consistent reading is that the notes exclude #4462 (chore(process): PROCESS_VERSION 166, the process-bump PR the process-changes section documents) — that gives exactly 193 — but this is an inference, not a stated fact. The features figure is stale either way; I find no rule that reproduces 58 from the sweep. Do not trust the "58 features" line as-is.
5. Sanity pass on the rest of the notes: git diff --stat 69f19a0e6..a893e1ad2 shows RELEASE_NOTES.md only (27 insertions, 14 deletions, 1 file). Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock are at 0.28.0 at this head (verified); the 155 decision files are deleted in the v0.27.0..release range (verified: 155 deleted under docs/decisions/, matching the body); CHANGELOG.md has 0.28.0 rows (verified); the body cut list states the cut line 2026-11-27T20:59Z (confirmed); the "What did not run" section in the body records the un-run steps (no Windows run, no cut runner, package step stopped at phase 8). None of those files were touched by the delta. Note: the 0.28.0 section of RECOMMENDED.md carries 159 decision headings (125 unique issues) against the 155 deleted files / 154-plus-one stated in the body and commits; worth one check next time, but not a delta regression.

Also of note (outside this delta's scope): #4513 is an OPEN P1 filed 2026-11-28T09:37:43Z, after the delta head's time window, and is not in the notes' open-P1/P2 list. It is not in any cut list. The list in the notes is otherwise exact: 12 of the 13 open P1 issues and all 33 open P2 issues are listed; only #4513 is missing.

Un-run steps: nothing for this review. No build, no gate, no heavy lane, no runner, no CI, no pr-test.yml. A docs/release-mechanics pass on the final head.

What this review does not cover: the cut gate, the release tier, tag and publish steps, and the P1/P2 open-list completeness beyond the spot checks above.
